name: example-messages_sender_cannot_read_nonpii
description: The baseline (10-role-allow) permits every low-risk CallTool, so a message-sender could still read NON-PII low-risk example-messages tools (about/health/configuration/identities/qrcodelink) that the PII forbid never touches. The send-only forbid in 20-example-message-roles.cedar must deny these. Pins that a sender is denied health.read (low, non-PII).
